안정형.name: Capital Preservation
안정형.description: A conservative profile that prioritizes protecting principal. Allocation centered on stable assets such as savings accounts is appropriate.

안정추구형.name: Conservative Growth
안정추구형.description: Seeks returns above savings while minimizing loss risk. Bond-heavy allocation is appropriate.

위험중립형.name: Balanced
위험중립형.description: Seeks a balance between risk and return. A balanced mix of bonds and equities is appropriate.

적극투자형.name: Active Growth
적극투자형.description: Accepts volatility for above-average returns. A portfolio with higher equity exposure is appropriate.

공격투자형.name: Aggressive Growth
공격투자형.description: Actively accepts short-term volatility for long-term high returns. Allocation focused on equities and high-volatility assets is appropriate.

cap.stable: Cap applied — 'Principal must be preserved' response limits to Capital Preservation level.
cap.neutral: Cap applied — 'Minimal loss only' response limits to Balanced level.
